value.rationale: A tight enclosing rectangle has a canonical role in computational and convex geometry; the result simultaneously identifies the worst normalized orientation-risk law for every convex penalty, gives aspect-ratio-free equality, and quantifies geometric departure via tangent direction dispersion. This is a structurally meaningful sharp distributional theorem, not just a tabulated moment or a renaming of the one-direction result.
